name: Bremen Stadt – LoD2
author: ninicoooooo
description:
Bremen and surroundings by NINICOO, with harbour districts, the Weser and 79 detailed LoD2 landmark entries via the companion mod ninicoo-bremen-landmarks.

Demand models 403,307 commuters in 44,954 origin–destination groups across 21,234 residential and job points. Residential locations are derived from the Zensus 2022 population grid with 100 × 100 metre cells. Municipality-level commuting is based on the official 2024 Pendlerrechnung (Regionaldatenbank table 19321-Z-22); 2022 employment statistics support the allocation to modelled job destinations. Each group contains a commuter count and car travel-time/distance values.

The point-level flows are a synthetic spatial allocation of aggregate statistics, not observations of individual journeys or measured employment counts for each building. Small and missing flows in the source statistics limit precision. The map-area census population is 965,312, distinct from the 403,307 represented commuters. Additional airport-passenger, student and leisure demand is not included.

Install the companion for detailed landmarks, road styling and foundations hidden by default.
data_source: Zensus 2022; Regionaldatenbank Deutschland 19321-Z-22 (2024); BA employment statistics (2022); OSM; Overture
